steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary containing one invited vendor's bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Use the required RFQ counter-offer configuration.
Enable buyer bid editing as required by the case.
Enable percentage counter offers as required by the case.
Open the Responses view named in the scenario.
Open the Edit Evaluation Time window from the RFQ Settings menu.
Capture the dialog's current evaluation end time before confirming.
Confirm without changing any radio selection.
Verify the expected successful update toast.
Reopen the dialog to read the resulting evaluation end time.
Verify the evaluation end time remains unchanged.
